notes.title: Challenges update notes
notes.content:
This is the big one! We have been working on single player and cooperative game mode for a while now, and here it is! So, grab a controller and and (optionally!) a friend and bash through some challenges!

Updates:
- Challenges game mode added (single player / cooperative)
- Full controller support fixed
- New weapons
- New battle levels
- Numerous other big and small fixes
